specification: For any tree and any identity: the result is exactly whether the identity is a proper descendant; on a miss the tree is structurally the same; on a hit the first matching direct child is removed, or else the removal recurses into exactly the first child subtree holding the identity, with every other node structurally the same and all non-tree fields of each ancestor unchanged. Terminates by the Vec element decrease axiom.

Loom.reason: The kernel holds no shared state and no synchronization primitive and takes the tree by &mut, so the compiler excludes concurrent access.
Loom.substitute_evidence: None added: the compiler's exclusive-borrow rule is the argument. It is not a concurrency proof.
